items.title: Omnipod 5 Upgrades Coming 2026 — Full CGM Interop, ML-Powered Insights, Omnipod 6 in 2027
items.summary: Insulet outlined a 3-year roadmap at its Innovation Showcase. Omnipod 5 upgrades (pending FDA clearance, expected 2026): full interoperability with all major CGMs, improved algorithm for better time-in-range, and Omnipod Discover — a machine-learning insights platform for real-time dose recommendations and streamlined onboarding. Omnipod 6 (2027) brings an adaptive algorithm that learns individual glucose patterns. By 2028, a Fully Closed Loop for Type 2 — zero carb counting, zero meal announcements, fully autonomous insulin delivery designed for primary care prescribing.
items.relevance: Kam uses Omnipod 5 — these upgrades are directly relevant. Full CGM interop means less vendor lock-in. The ML insights platform could change how dose adjustments are made. For AVA's simulation, modeling adaptive algorithms (like Omnipod 6's learning system) could be an advanced teaching feature — showing kids how their pump learns their patterns over time.

items.title: ChatGPT Now Shows Ads to Free & Go Users — Anthropic Counters by Going Ad-Free & Expanding Free Tier
items.summary: OpenAI officially began testing ads in ChatGPT for US users on Free and Go tiers this week. Ads are labeled, non-personalized, and only shown to logged-in adults. Paid tiers (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise) remain ad-free. Days later, Anthropic responded by expanding Claude's free tier to include file creation, third-party connectors (Slack, Notion, Zapier, Figma), skills, and compaction — all previously paid features. Anthropic explicitly committed to keeping Claude ad-free.
items.relevance: A strategic divergence in the AI business model war. OpenAI is going the ad-supported route while Anthropic is betting on premium conversion by giving more away free. For devs like Kam, Claude's free connectors (Slack, Notion, Zapier) make it a free automation hub. If you recommend tools to other T1D devs, Claude free tier is now genuinely powerful.

items.title: ByteDance Building 'SeedChip' AI Processor — 100K Units in 2026 via Samsung
items.summary: ByteDance is developing an in-house AI chip codenamed SeedChip and is in manufacturing talks with Samsung Electronics. The TikTok parent aims to produce at least 100,000 units in 2026, scaling to 350,000. Previously ByteDance worked with Broadcom and TSMC, but US export restrictions are pushing the company toward Samsung's foundry. At a January all-hands, ByteDance acknowledged its AI models still lag OpenAI but pledged continued heavy investment.
items.relevance: The AI chip race is fragmenting. ByteDance building custom silicon signals that every major tech company now considers AI compute a strategic asset, not something you just rent from Nvidia. Long-term this could affect AI API pricing and availability — more competition in chips means lower costs for everyone building AI products.

items.title: GitHub Octoverse: TypeScript Overtakes Python as #1 Language, AI Reshaping How Software Is Built
items.summary: GitHub's latest Octoverse data shows TypeScript overtook Python and JavaScript as the most-used language on GitHub in 2025, adding over 1 million contributors. Python grew 48.78% YoY (~850K new contributors), while JavaScript grew slower at 24.79%. The report highlights that the fastest-growing tools aren't about writing more code — they're about reducing friction. Typed languages win in AI-assisted workflows because type systems give AI models better context for code generation.
items.relevance: TypeScript's rise is directly tied to AI coding tools — type annotations give Claude Code and Copilot much better context for generating correct code. If you're starting new projects (like command center or AVA backend services), TypeScript is the clear choice. Python remains king for AI/ML work. SwiftUI already has strong typing, which is why Claude Code works well with it.

items.title: Tandem Diabetes Care Q4 2025 Earnings Coming Feb 19 — Analysts Bullish with 38% Upside
items.summary: Tandem Diabetes Care reports Q4 2025 earnings on February 19. Analysts expect revenue of $277M (up from $249M in Q3) and near-breakeven EPS of -$0.06. The stock has 38.4% potential upside according to analyst consensus. Tandem's t:slim X2 pump continues to be a market leader in AID systems. Stifel Nicolaus raised its price target, citing strong adoption trends.
items.relevance: Kaislyn uses the Tandem t:slim X2 — this is her pump company. Strong earnings would mean continued R&D investment in the platform. Worth watching the Feb 19 report for any announcements about next-gen features, Dexcom G8 compatibility, or Mobi pump expansion. If Tandem stock pops, it signals the diabetes tech market is healthy — good for AVA's target ecosystem.

items.title: AI Reads Brain MRI Scans in Seconds — University of Michigan Breakthrough
items.summary: Researchers at the University of Michigan created an AI system that interprets brain MRI scans in seconds, accurately identifying a wide range of neurological conditions and determining which cases need urgent care. The system can flag critical findings for immediate radiologist review while routing routine scans for standard processing, potentially transforming emergency neurology workflows.
items.relevance: Another example of AI excelling at medical pattern recognition — the same fundamental approach that makes CGM trend prediction possible. This kind of real-time medical AI validates the broader ecosystem AVA operates in: technology making healthcare faster and more accessible. The triage angle (urgent vs. routine) is a pattern that could apply to glucose alerts too.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Deploys Anthropic's Claude Agents for Trade Accounting & Client Onboarding
items.summary: Goldman Sachs is building AI agents using Anthropic's Claude to automate trade accounting and client onboarding workflows. The agents handle repetitive compliance tasks, cross-reference documentation, and flag exceptions for human review. Blackstone also increased its stake in Anthropic to ~$1 billion. Enterprise adoption of Claude agents is accelerating across finance, legal, and operations.
items.relevance: Anthropic's enterprise push validates the agent architecture you're already using with Clawdbot. Goldman deploying Claude agents for real financial workflows means the underlying technology is being trusted with high-stakes work. Blackstone's $1B stake signals Anthropic isn't going anywhere — long-term stability for the tools you're building on.

items.title: Taiwan Hikes 2026 GDP Forecast to 7.7% — AI Chip Demand Driving Economic Boom
items.summary: Taiwan's government raised its 2026 economic growth forecast to 7.7%, up from previous estimates, driven almost entirely by surging global demand for AI chips. TSMC continues to be the world's most critical semiconductor manufacturer, with AI accelerator orders (from Nvidia, Apple, AMD, and others) filling capacity through 2027. The AI hardware boom is now a macroeconomic force.
items.relevance: The AI boom is now reshaping entire national economies. This matters for long-term API pricing — as chip supply scales up over the next 1-2 years, AI inference costs should continue dropping, making tools like Claude Code and Clawdbot cheaper to run. Good macro trend for indie builders like you.
